decision_conditions: The development to which this permission relates must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of the decision notice. Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan DPL.04.AEXISTING and PROPOSED DRAWINGS - garage conversion DPL.01.CPROPOSED DRAWINGS - garage convers. DPL.02.CSPECS. - garage conversion DPL.03.BPROPOSED DRAWINGS - garage convers. DPL.04.AReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

All new external work shall be carried out in materials that match the existing or as specified in the approved application.Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area.
description: Conversion of garage into habitable room involving alterations to front elevation and construction of front patio/hardstand.
